title: [AINews] Agents disprove Polysemanticity; greatly improve Interpretability & Alignment
author: Latent Space
description: Nick Cammarata out of nowhere with some major claims!
summary: A version of Muse Spark Open was released today, fulfilling their original promise but with a model weaker than their Spark 1.3. It’s also worth watching the Tesla Roadster demo - not strictly AI but nothing cooler than real life flying cars.
takeaways: Other Model Launches: Nemotron 3.5, MAI-Base-2, Gemini 4 Argon, Image Models NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL : The model is a 120B / 12B-active hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE VLM with a 1M-token context window and native MTP ( NVIDIA ).
Training recipe : The tech summary describes a 1T-token distillation from a larger Nemotron 3 teacher, followed by agentic SWE mid-training on 65.4B tokens at 256K context.
AI Twitter Recap Meta Releases Muse Spark Open, the Top-Scoring US Open-Weight Model Release : Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816B-total / 42B-active MoE with a 1M-token context window.
